Passed on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (reviewed_by stays null); no hardware was attached and neither the hardware nor the sim backend was run. The upstream Taichi/FEM/MPM simulator was not installed, imported or executed, and the fake was never compared with it. Upstream does not register a Gymnasium id: training_rl.py:95-96 constructs TactileEnv directly with the task env_kwargs, so the bridge's gym.make(env_id) path has no id and this package lists only the fake backend; the card's GymnasiumDriver shape still expresses the environment's Box action space and its step/reset returns, so there is no DEVIATION FROM THE CARD. The fake returns the full state observation of the registered box_open task, 544 particle positions x 3 coordinates + 6 sensor pose values = 1638 values; the tactile observation branch has 1913 values (register_tasks.py:74-75) and is NOT COVERED: the tactile marker/force array. The fake's physics, particle values, pose and reward delta are placeholders. Also NOT COVERED: rendering (upstream render needs Taichi GUI handles), snapshot/restore (TactileEnv exposes no get_state/set_state), and wall-clock pacing (lockstep only). Expected warnings left as the bridge derives them: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only records the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.values[*] and seed in cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 (the simulator's own units are described in the inputs/fidelity). There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are bound, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line of the last check; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
